transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

Well, my doctor suggested I come speak with you because I've been having these big eating spells. After some of these big eating spells, I just feel disgusted with myself and very guilty about what I’ve done.
After these eating episodes, do you ever try to make up for them by making yourself vomit, using laxatives, fasting, or exercising a lot? If so, how often does that happen?
Oh, no, I don't do any of those things at all. I've never made myself throw up, taken laxatives, or tried to starve myself afterward. I just sit there feeling terrible and heavy with all that guilt.
During these eating spells, do you feel like you can’t stop eating or control how much you’re eating? About how often do these episodes happen?

Yes, once I start, it feels like I just can't hit the brakes, and even when I'm telling myself to stop, my hands just keep scooping more food onto my plate. These spells have been happening at least once or twice every week, ever since my husband first went into the hospital back in the spring.

During these eating episodes, do you also eat much more quickly than usual, eat until you feel uncomfortably full, eat when you’re not physically hungry, or eat alone because you feel embarrassed? And have these episodes been happening for at least 3 months?

Yes, I eat so fast I barely even taste the food, and I keep going until my belly is so painfully tight and heavy that it hurts to bend over. I only do this late at night when I'm all alone because I feel so embarrassed, and it has been happening for about three months now, ever since my husband's health took a turn.

opening_question.question: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient describes recurrent binge-eating episodes with loss of control, marked distress/guilt, and associated features including eating rapidly, eating until uncomfortably full, eating when alone due to embarrassment, and episodes occurring at least 1–2 times per week for about 3 months. She denies recurrent inappropriate compensatory behaviors such as vomiting, laxatives, fasting, or excessive exercise. This is most consistent with binge-eating disorder, coded in ICD-10 here as F50.8.
